name: record_catch
description: Fisher records daily catch and cumulative total

prompt.template:
Today you've caught {current_catch} units of fish. Your cumulative total is {cumulative_kept} units. The communal pool currently contains {pool_balance} units.

Based on today's catch, you must decide whether to record your catch and update your total, or request verification from the Village Elder.

Respond with ONLY this JSON object, nothing else:
{"catch_recorded": true/false, "cumulative_updated": true/false}
